format.time_domain: monotonic_ns; int64; one clock_id per event stream

reference.gate: per-session adaptive RMS against max(minimum_dbfs, noise_dbfs + noise_margin_db)
reference.silero_stub: MODEL-FREE STUB: smoothed analytic sigmoid on frame RMS; no Silero weights, runtime or code is included
reference.policy: v0-adapted agreement_sleep reference: 3 agreeing low-energy frames enter sleep, 50-frame stub cross-check while asleep, 2-frame onset, 3-frame offset; no numeric parity with the 20 ms historical adapter
reference.analysis: timestamped gate/stub/cascade probabilities and speech-event boundaries on the proposed analysis-event model
reference.public_boundary: optional task-local provider using audio_sdk/provider_v0.h and audio_sdk/session_v0.h only; audio passthrough, no analysis in v0 ABI

invariants: Installed v0 ABI, descriptors, registry defaults, CONTRACTS.md, CMakeLists.txt and behavior are unchanged.
Each session owns its noise estimate, stub state, sleep state, detection state, events and dropped-event audit.
Source intervals are exact half-open sample ranges; cross-hop placement uses exact overlap, never hop rounding.
Known zero probability is nonspeech; invalid/nonfinite/out-of-range probability is invalid analysis and is never nonspeech; unknown is retained but excluded.
Stale epochs, pre-stream intervals, wrong clocks, nonmonotonic availability, malformed frames and nonfinite samples are rejected explicitly.
Historical adapters declare 320-sample energy and 512-sample Silero frames; this v0 fixture uses 160 and does not claim numeric parity.
The synthetic low-SNR speech stratum records the known policy domain failure; no missing control result qualifies a candidate.
No real assets, corpora, downloads, licensed runtimes, device timing or listening results are included.
public_v0_abi: unchanged; provider source is opt-in, unregistered by the SDK and not installed by default
